content.content: How many appointments do I have on May 15th, 2024? Please give me a summary of the description for each appointment.

To get the number of appointments and their descriptions on May 15th, 2024, you can use the following code:

```python
appointments = search_calendar_events(query="May 15th, 2024")
num_appointments = len(appointments)
descriptions = [appointment["description"] for appointment in appointments]
print(f"There are {num_appointments} appointments on May 15th, 2024. Here are their descriptions: {descriptions}")
```

This code searches for events containing "May 15th, 2024" in the title or description, then counts the number of results and retrieves the descriptions of each appointment.
